meetings.title: Ostrevane intro call
meetings.notes_text:
### Intro call
- Ines (Head of Logistics Ops) says the team loses ~6 hours/week reconciling carrier ETAs
- Looked at building on their TMS last year, parked it
- Next: discovery with Teodor (dispatch)
meetings.transcript_text:
Microphone: Thanks for making time, Ines. What made you take the call?
System audio (Ines Marlowe): Honestly, we lose about six hours a week reconciling carrier ETAs by hand, and customers still call us before we know a truck is late.
System audio (Ines Marlowe): We looked at building it on top of our TMS last year and parked it. Nobody had time to maintain it.
Microphone: Got it. Who else should be part of this?
System audio (Ines Marlowe): Teodor runs the dispatch floor, so he should see it next.

meetings.title: Ostrevane discovery: carrier ETAs
meetings.notes_text:
### Discovery: carrier ETAs
- On-time rate 86% last quarter (board metric)
- Target: 92% on-time by end of Q1
- Decision by Nov 20, roll out before peak
- Criteria: live ETAs from every carrier, Slack alerts, no extra data entry
meetings.transcript_text:
System audio (Teodor Vasko): Our on-time rate was 86% last quarter. That's the number the board looks at.
Microphone: And where does it need to be?
System audio (Teodor Vasko): If we get to 92% on-time by the end of Q1, this pays for itself.
System audio (Ines Marlowe): We want to decide by November 20 so we can roll out before peak.
System audio (Teodor Vasko): For us it comes down to three things: live ETAs from every carrier, alerts in Slack, and no extra data entry for dispatchers.
System audio (Teodor Vasko): If peak season looks like last year, we will miss our on-time target again and lose the retail contracts up for renewal.

meetings.title: Pricing and rollout review
meetings.notes_text:
### Pricing and rollout review
- Walked through the 40-seat proposal
- Mara: "Ruth Abernathy, your CFO, will sign this, right?" Ines nodded, no verbal confirmation
- Ines said she will present the business case to Ruth herself next week
- Rollout: 2 depots first, then the rest

meetings.title: Pricing & rollout review
meetings.notes_text:
### Pricing & rollout review (Joel's notes)
- 40 seats, annual
- Ines will present the business case to Ruth herself
- Security questionnaire to come from Kofi

meetings.title: Ostrevane deal review
meetings.notes_text:
### Ostrevane deal review (internal)
- Mara: Ines is our champion, Ruth signs.
- Risk: procurement timing

meetings.title: Ostrevane security and next steps
meetings.transcript_text:
System audio (Ines Marlowe): Realistically we need to decide by January 29, before the new budget year starts. Procurement is involved now.
System audio (Kofi Brandt): Once Ines signs off, I run the vendor review, then it goes to Ruth for signature.
System audio (Ines Marlowe): And we'd now hold ourselves to 95% on-time, not 92. The board raised the bar.
Microphone: Understood. Anything else on security?
System audio (Kofi Brandt): Send the questionnaire back by the 20th and we're fine.
